takes.script: [scared kid] It's MINE! [taking charge, urgent] Tata, get UP, it's getting away!

takes.line: d|grace|Nine papers. There were twelve. So the one with the pan still has three.
takes.label: new take
takes.script: [counting, small teacher] Nine papers. There were twelve. [working it out] So the one with the pan still has three.

takes.line: d|grace|It's grey, Rose. Just that one spot. And that orange cube has a dragonfly in it.
takes.label: new take
takes.script: [correcting, patient] It's grey, Rose. Just that one spot. [curious, slower] And that orange cube has a dragonfly in it.

takes.line: d|grace|Deedee, what's that?
takes.label: new take
takes.script: [curious] Deedee, what's that?

takes.line: d|grace|Tata, stop. You're getting fingerprints on it. And look, it has a dent. Did you do that?
takes.label: new take
takes.script: [bossy] Tata, stop. You're getting fingerprints on it. [noticing] And look, it has a dent. [suspicious] Did YOU do that?

takes.line: d|grace|Don't throw it out! It's a clue. I'm starting a new list. Burnt bulb. Grey grass. Orange cube with a dragonfly in it. I'm writing it in pencil.
takes.label: new take
takes.script: [alarmed] Don't throw it out! [important] It's a clue. I'm starting a new list. [writing, one at a time] Burnt bulb. Grey grass. Orange cube with a dragonfly in it. [firm] I'm writing it in PENCIL.

takes.line: d|grace|Because I don't know what any of it means yet.
takes.label: new take
takes.script: [honest, plain] Because I don't know what any of it MEANS yet.

takes.line: d|grace|I know, Tata. You're squeezing. Is that the Big One? Boppy only said it was as big as the couch!
takes.label: new take
takes.script: [small, scared] I know, Tata. You're squeezing. [loud question] Is that the Big One? Boppy only said it was as big as the COUCH!

takes.line: d|grace|The fish ate them, Boppy. The last three.
takes.label: new take
takes.script: [plain, reporting] The fish ate them, Boppy. The last three.

takes.line: d|grace|That's Boppy. He's here every single day.
takes.label: new take
takes.script: [surprised] That's Boppy. [plain] He's here every single day.

takes.line: d|grace|That's my second best one. Don't lose it.
takes.label: new take
takes.script: [reluctant, sideways] That's my second best one. [firm] Don't LOSE it.

takes.line: d|grace|Tata, you have a job. If you see anything grey in California, or an orange cube, you write it down and text me.
takes.label: new take
takes.script: [bossy, serious] Tata, you have a JOB. If you see anything grey in California, or an orange cube, you write it down and text me.

takes.line: d|grace|It's limited edition. There are only two in the whole world. You can squeeze it!
takes.label: new take
takes.script: [angry] It's limited edition. [dramatic, hushed] There are only two in the whole world. [generous, bright] You can squeeze it!
